verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents several first-party APIs: an Alerts API, a Case API for creating and updating cases, list and fetch endpoints, a batch case import API, and a filing API to validate, file and monitor status. API keys are managed in organization settings, so the core workflows can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: endpoint-level reference documentation or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed spec paths returned 404), authentication and usage details beyond the API Keys setting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
